source_conflicts.page_count: Merchant overlay says 200 paper; CJ says no sheet/page count. Not corroborated.
source_conflicts.name: Merchant says A5 buckle charming black; CJ variant confirms Charming Black only. A5 and buckle are not confirmed by text fields.

source_facts.pages: Not explicitly stated. 200 sheets could mean 400 written sides conventionally, but CJ does not state 400 pages.
source_facts.base_included: Packing list says Notebook x1 pc. Exact variant name says Purple Plus Stickers. Product description lists the purple sticker option as including 8 planning stickers; this corresponds to this variant's Plus Stickers name.

source_conflicts.dimensions: Merchant overlay says 150x211 mm; CJ gives variant logistics dimensions 220x160x30 mm and not the notebook's opened/closed body or writing area. Not a like-for-like measurement.
source_conflicts.sheet_count: Merchant overlay says 200 sheets; CJ description also says 200 sheets. Corroborated.
source_conflicts.paper_weight: Merchant overlay says 80G; CJ description says internal paper weight 80g. Corroborated, though CJ doesn't specify GSM in English string.
source_conflicts.page_count: Merchant says 400 pages; CJ says 200 sheets and leaves page/side counting unstated. 400 pages is inferred, not CJ-confirmed.
source_conflicts.variant: Exact CJ SKU is Purple Plus Stickers, not plain Purple; Shopify variant given is labeled Purple. Verify whether 8 planning stickers are included in that Shopify mapping.

notebookCJLimits:
# CJ source facts for LuxeStyle notebook variants

Read-only product detail lookups on 2026-11-13 UTC. Exact SKU matches were returned for both requested variant codes. See JSON for source fields and image URLs.

## Charmantes Schwarz
- CJ confirms the exact variant name “Charming Black,” PU cover, wood-free paper, and a packing list of one notebook.
- CJ does not state paper weight, number of sheets/pages, inner paper dimensions, or notebook body dimensions. Its variant logistics dimensions are 240 × 80 × 227 mm; do not present these as the writing area.
- CJ lists separate Charming Black Upgrade and Charming Black Luxury options, but gives no textual explanation of what they add. Merchant’s A5/buckle claims are not confirmed by CJ text. The “200 paper” overlay is not corroborated.
- Photo URLs and variant image are in the JSON; image resolution was not requested. Rights for advertising use are unknown.

## Purple
- CJ confirms the exact variant “Purple Plus Stickers,” PU cover, thread binding, wood-free paper, 80g internal paper, and 200 sheets. The description’s option list says purple includes 8 planning stickers; packing list says one notebook.
- Merchant’s 80G and 200 sheets are corroborated. “400 pages” is a conventional two-sided inference, not explicitly stated by CJ.
- Merchant overlay’s 150 × 211 mm is not like-for-like with CJ’s 220 × 160 × 30 mm variant logistics dimensions. CJ does not state notebook body or writing-area dimensions.
- Check whether Shopify’s “Purple” mapping intentionally corresponds to the CJ “Purple Plus Stickers” SKU. Photo URLs are in JSON; resolution and advertising rights are unknown.
